name: Unsewn Undead: Crawling Hands
body:
UNSEWN UNDEAD: CRAWLING HANDS
CR 1/3

XP 135
CE Diminutive undead
Init +4; darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 18, flat-footed 14 (+4 Dex, +4 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +0, Ref +4, Will +2
Defensive Abilities Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee claw +8 (1d2-2 plus grab)
Space 1 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks grab, choke

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 19, Con —, Int 1, Wis 10, Cha 6
Base Atk +0; CMB +0 (+4 grapple); CMD 8
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +12, Perception +4, Stealth +16
Languages —
SQ spider climb (constant)

ABOUT

Severed at the wrists, these desiccated hands skitter across walls and ceilings using constant spider climb.

They drop from dark ceiling rafters onto adventurers’ faces, wrapping around throats to choke spellcasters and prevent verbal spellcasting.
